text: “He’s unhappy.” “Oh, dear!” said Lucy. “How can he be unhappy when he is strong and alive? What more is one to give him? And think how he has been brought up—free from all the superstition and ignorance that lead men to hate one another in the name of God. With such an education as that, I thought he was bound to grow up happy.” She was no theologian, but she felt that here was a very foolish old man, as well as a very irreligious one.
